name: Heek (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Heek (a bishop on yellow and a red castle on white).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident of 10 July 1972 the municipality was granted the right to bear arms, a flag, a banner and an official seal; the banner is striped lengthwise in two equal stripes of yellow and red with the arms.
